Subject: What our staff is actually packing this winter
CTA: See the staff picks when they're live -> https://www.northbaysupply.com/staff-picks/winter
Body: Hey,

Every winter, a few of us sit down and talk through what's actually making it into our packs — not what we wish we had, not what looks good on a hang tag, but what earned its place on the last trip.

This year we ran into a problem: our catalog is still being updated for the season, and we're not going to send you a list of gear we can't fully stand behind with facts in hand.

So here's where we are — our staff picks for winter are coming together, and we want to get them right before we put them in front of you. When that list is ready, it'll be specific: what the piece does, where it works, and where it doesn't. No filler.

Check back at the link below in the next few days. We'll have the picks posted and our notes alongside them.

Stay warm out there.
